children.name: text
children.text: This ring was born almost playfully, starting from the form of a realistic beetle that was deliberately deconstructed and transformed into something new. The rigor of the figure was released, giving way to freedom and experimentation, dissolving into a more abstract and spontaneous gesture. A light yet meaningful creative process that speaks of transformation: as in life, what ends does not disappear, but changes form and continues to exist, revealing unexpected beauty.

Its marked surface speaks of erosion by the elements: one side strong and resistant, the other crossed by fissures that let the light seep through. An imperfect balance that reflects the beauty of nature and the memory it carries.
